description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. One matter from first instance through appeal to cassation (pirmoji / apeliacinė / kasacinė instancija): the held rulings (nutartys) grouped by proceeding number (teisminio proceso numeris), in date order with each court's level. Use it to see what later happened to a judgment, or which lower decisions a cassation ruling reviewed. Pass `case_no` for one judgment or `proceeding_no` when you have the register number. Finality is not inferred: the answer says `unknown` when the held rulings do not show it, and a ruling the corpus does not hold is missing from the chain. For citations between different cases use cited_by and citations_of. Example arguments: {"case_no": "e3K-3-117-823/2023"}.

case_no.description: One judgment's case number (e.g. `e3K-3-117-823/2023`). Returns every held ruling in that proceeding, ordered by date and court level. Omit when you pass `proceeding_no`.
case_no.title: Case No

jurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction to search (`LT`). Omit for the account's own.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

proceeding_no.description: The teisminio proceso numeris (e.g. `1-01-2-00032-2021-4`) when you already have it. Returns the whole held chain for that matter. Omit when you pass `case_no`.
proceeding_no.title: Proceeding No

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: instance_chain
title: Instance chain of a case
